stories.title: 3 teens arrested after allegedly assaulting couple on TriMet bus in Southeast Portland
stories.summary: The teenagers broke the bus's window and damaged its windshield wipers before leaving the area but were taken into custody, Multnomah County Sheriff’s Office said.

stories.title: Oregon Republicans eye 2028 ballot measure to ban transgender girls from school sports
stories.summary: Rep. Ed Diehl says conservative lawmakers are considering putting the issue before Oregon voters, while LGBTQ+ advocates are already preparing to fight it.

stories.title: PBOT is cleaning leaves off the streets. In some areas, failure to move could get your car towed
stories.summary: Starting Thursday, "Leaf Day" cleanup begins in zones where moving cars out of the way is not optional: violators will be towed, the city says.

stories.title: OHSU hoping to expand access to health care education with new partnerships, scholarships
stories.summary: OHSU leaders warned that without financial support to growing educational costs, some professionals will be unable to finish their health care programs.

stories.title: Fireworks linked to deadly Chelan Hills Fire; 5 charged, 1 suspect sought
stories.summary: Newly released evidence by the Douglas County Sheriff's Office reveals the investigative process leading to the arrests of five people.

stories.title: Portland City Council will consider whether to block any new AI tools for a year
stories.summary: Council President Jamie Dunphy has brought forward a one-year moratorium on new uses of artificial intelligence. The council is set to consider it early next month.

stories.title: Oregon sues OpenAI for $2 billion, accuses company of failing to protect kids
stories.summary: The suit aims to protect children from potential exposure to dangerous messages through the company's chatbot, ChatGPT.

stories.title: Washington, Oregon health officials urge vaccination after US loses measles elimination status
stories.summary: The U.S. has lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, prompting West Coast states to urge vaccinations amidst rising cases.

stories.title: Oregon crime reports continue to decline, FBI says, after pandemic-era rise
stories.summary: Reports of both violent and property crime continued to fall from 2024 into 2025, according to federal statistics, a trend which has continued into this year.

stories.title: Lake Oswego teen loses eye in sleepover e-bike crash; mother sues for $8.7M
stories.summary: Surgeons repaired his skull after a sleepover crash. His family says the e-bikes were banned for minors under Oregon law, and the lawsuit seeks millions.

stories.title: Portland police respond to trio of shootings overnight in the central city
stories.summary: Several people were injured but there were no deaths after a flurry of shootings early Sunday morning.

stories.title: The Grammy nominations are out. Here's where Portland fits in
stories.summary: The biggest names in music aren't the only Grammy stories worth following. Portland has a few connections of its own.
